title: Create the client API adapter and runtime device credential store
acceptance_criteria: The adapter uses a runtime-configured API base URL and typed fetch calls for pair, push upload, schedule upload, status, and revoke operations.

Pairing credentials are stored only in a dedicated browser runtime storage key after HTTPS pairing; they are never placed in source, Vite build variables, logs, or the existing fitness storage envelope.
The adapter bounds payloads, handles non-2xx responses without exposing response secrets, and distinguishes missing credentials from network failure.
Pure client tests cover serialization, authorization headers, successful pairing, existing credentials, invalid responses, and safe failure behavior.
completion_summary: Implemented HTTPS runtime-configured push API calls, bounded response validation, safe error classes, and isolated device credential storage with pure tests.
